reason: Automates DeepSeek call cost measurement and rating while dynamically tuning the max_tokens output budget and presenting metrics in the web interface.

summaries.zh: 用于统计和评级 DeepSeek 调用的 token、缓存命中率与费用，并自动调节 max_tokens 输出预算及展示调用指标。
summaries.en: Measures and rates DeepSeek calls by token usage, cache hit rate, and cost while automatically tuning the max_tokens output budget and displaying call metrics.

capabilities: Measures token output, cache hit rate, and call cost
Rates DeepSeek calls using configurable thresholds
Automatically adjusts max_tokens through a dial-based budget
Fetches and synchronizes pricing from the official DeepSeek pricing page
Displays call ratings and metrics in the web interface
Provides slash commands for status, reset, manual dial adjustment, and price synchronization
